title.zh: SmartLingo V2 Max 一对一角色教师
title.en: SmartLingo V2 Max one-to-one role tutor

purpose.zh: 开放 Max 会员的十二种生活场景一对一 AI 角色练习，并让学习者通过打字或按键说话完成真实应答。
purpose.en: Open one-to-one AI role practice across twelve everyday scenes for Max learners, with typed or push-to-talk replies.

zh: 复用已验证的场景、语言、等级和 AI 网关，开放期限受控的 Max 一对一角色练习；教师按引导、情境变化和独立迁移三阶段回应。
在角色练习中加入按键录音转写、教师朗读及慢速重听；非 Max 用户可主动开启一次七天试用，浏览页面不会自动试用。
en: Reuse validated scenes, languages, levels, and the AI gateway for expiry-gated Max role practice; the tutor progresses through guided, situational, and independent-response phases.
Add push-to-talk transcription, tutor speech and slow replay; non-Max members may explicitly begin a one-time seven-day trial without page-view activation.

zh: 影响生活口语任务完成后的 Max 入口、角色导师页面与接口、录音转写接口以及 Free/Max 说明；不改变支付或订阅价格。
en: Affects the Max link after everyday missions, the role tutor page and APIs, speech transcription endpoint, and Free/Max copy; payment and subscription prices are unchanged.

zh: 服务端逐次核验登录、Max 到期时间、场景归属、会话所有权、十分钟期限和十二次回复上限；语音从会话读取学习语言，失败的 AI 回复不消耗会话轮次。
en: The server checks sign-in, Max expiry, scene ownership, session ownership, ten-minute expiry, and twelve-reply cap on each turn; speech derives language from the session and failed AI replies do not consume a session turn.

zh: 角色与会话单元测试、全站测试、TypeScript、零警告 lint、构建和发布门禁；部署后核验匿名与普通会员浏览器路径及 Project 发布记录。
en: Role and session tests, full-site tests, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, build and release gates; then anonymous and ordinary-member browser checks and the exact Project release record.

zh: 本轮语音是按键录音、转写及浏览器朗读，不是全双工实时 WebRTC；旧实时接口继续关闭。语音专用的试用每天 10 分钟／付费每天 30 分钟计时、正式评测、成绩持久化和重试历史留待后续发布。
en: This release uses push-to-talk, transcription, and browser speech rather than full-duplex realtime WebRTC; the legacy live endpoint remains closed. Dedicated 10-minute trial and 30-minute paid daily voice metering, formal assessment, saved scores, and retry history remain for later release.

zh: 只复用 SmartLingo 已验证的场景数据、Max 订阅、AI 网关、语音转写和朗读组件，不引入新供应商或跨站数据。
en: Reuse SmartLingo's validated scene data, Max subscription, AI gateway, transcription, and speech components without a new provider or cross-site data.

rollback.zh: 可回退到上一成功提交，或将 SMARTLINGO_ROLE_TUTOR_ENABLED 设为 0 关闭入口；此轮没有 D1 结构迁移。
rollback.en: Revert to the previous successful commit or set SMARTLINGO_ROLE_TUTOR_ENABLED to 0 to close the entry; this release has no D1 schema migration.
